why_ai: Fiduciary active-investment judgment with slow noisy feedback, but passive and quant products keep taking flows.
why_clarity: Alpha versus benchmark is measurable, yet each PM's process is personal and results take years.
why_digital: Research runs on filings, data and models; mandates still won through consultant meetings and finals presentations.

why_ai: Contributed compensation survey data is a moat AI cannot generate; strategy advice rides on consultant relationships.
why_clarity: Comp surveys are recurring and defined, but strategy engagements have fuzzy success and slow payoff.
why_digital: Survey data and reports are digital; strategy engagements are sold through senior consultant relationships.

why_ai: AI absorbs reading and monitoring, but forecasting judgment on investments stays human and high-stakes.
why_clarity: Recommendations are graded by noisy returns months later; analysts each work by personal method.
why_digital: Filings, transcripts and models on screens, with some management meetings in person.

why_ai: Database value rests on manager-submitted histories; collection and analytics are routine and automatable.
why_clarity: Quarterly structured submissions recur identically; quality hinges on unverified self-reporting.
why_digital: Data in, database and analytics tools out, sold remotely to consultants.

why_ai: Covenant reading and surveillance automate well; downside calls before downgrades remain consequential judgment.
why_clarity: Avoiding defaults is a clear goal across many issuers, but losses reveal mistakes only later.
why_digital: Offering documents, covenants and spreads are all read and analysed on screens.

why_ai: Producing track records and consultant-ready evidence is standard ops work AI-native platforms can supply.
why_clarity: Evidence packages match consultant screens with defined pass criteria and repeat quarterly.
why_digital: Outsourced operations, data and reporting delivered remotely to small managers.

why_ai: Fiduciary manager-of-managers selection for public pensions depends on relationships and slow-feedback judgment.
why_clarity: Due diligence follows a process, but manager selection quality shows only over years.
why_digital: Due diligence files plus onsite manager visits; public pension mandates won through relationships.

why_ai: Ratings derive from public disclosures AI can read; only brand and regulatory authorisation protect.
why_clarity: Thousands of repeated ratings, but rating providers disagree on what they even measure.
why_digital: Disclosures and controversies in, ratings and data feeds out, sold globally.

why_ai: Analytics are calculable software; durability comes from holding the servicing relationship and the data.
why_clarity: Daily NAV and month-end performance calculations recur and reconcile objectively.
why_digital: Servicing data processed into performance and risk analytics, sold through bank enterprise sales.

why_ai: Boards need an independent provider for fiduciary contract approval, though peer group builds are automatable.
why_clarity: Annual fee and performance peer comparisons follow established construction rules each cycle.
why_digital: Public fund data analysed on screens, delivered as board presentations to relationship clients.

why_ai: Proprietary intermediary flow records protect the vendor; the analysis itself is routine and automatable.
why_clarity: Monthly flow datasets are assembled the same way and checked against filings.
why_digital: Transaction data in, datasets and sales tools out, licensed remotely.

why_ai: Member-funded associations keep authority and member data series; policy advocacy needs standing, not just analysis.
why_clarity: Fact books recur on schedule, but policy research success is political and slow.
why_digital: Member data and publications are digital; advocacy runs through membership and regulator meetings.

why_ai: Explicit rules on shared data make filings automatable; treasurer certification keeps some accountability.
why_clarity: Every figure must tie to the book of record under a specific rule.
why_digital: Book-of-record data into regulatory filings and fund documents, all electronic.

why_ai: Reading management credibility before numbers confirm it is novel judgment; monitoring and recall automate.
why_clarity: Price targets are defined, but method is personal and correctness shows only after quarters.
why_digital: Transcripts and models on screens, with management meetings partly in person.

why_ai: Benchmark brands and licensing are entrenched under benchmark regulation; AI speeds custom index design.
why_clarity: Index methodologies are written rulebooks with exact, checkable calculations.
why_digital: Market data in, index levels and licences out, sold globally.

why_ai: Pension boards pay trusted consultants for fiduciary manager ratings whose quality shows only over years.
why_clarity: Ratings follow a shared method across thousands of strategies, but outcomes resolve slowly.
why_digital: Manager meetings and onsite diligence feed reports presented in person at client board meetings.

why_ai: Trade-history analytics are software on digital inputs; firms could build them in-house with AI.
why_clarity: Decision attribution is computable from trades, but PM acceptance of fairness is subjective.
why_digital: Trade data in, analytics dashboards out, sold as remote software.

why_ai: Analytics modules are software built on platforms clients are locked into, not human expertise.
why_clarity: Usage and benchmarking analytics are defined product features shipped on release cycles.
why_digital: Platform data in, software analytics out, sold to global enterprise clients.

why_ai: Risk reporting and limit monitoring automate; regulatory risk oversight keeps an accountable function.
why_clarity: Factor models are codified and run daily; realised tracking error checks forecasts over months.
why_digital: Positions and factor data processed in risk platforms entirely on screens.

why_ai: Acquisition decisions on boutique stakes are high-stakes and relationship-driven; affiliate reporting automates.
why_clarity: Affiliate reviews recur, but deal analysis is bespoke and pays off years later.
why_digital: Affiliate financial data analysed on screens; deals negotiated with founders in person.

why_ai: An independent verifier must attest GIPS compliance, though composite testing itself is rule-based.
why_clarity: GIPS standards define exact composite and calculation tests that recur annually.
why_digital: Composite and performance records verified from workpapers and delivered as reports remotely.

why_ai: Applying vote policies to public proxy filings is exactly what AI can do for managers directly.
why_clarity: Benchmark and custom policies applied to thousands of similar meeting agendas each season.
why_digital: Public filings in, research reports and electronic votes out, sold globally.

why_ai: Repeated questions answered from structured data are directly substituted by LLM answer engines.
why_clarity: Each answer must match the exact strategy, vehicle and quarter, checkable against prior submissions.
why_digital: Answer libraries and databases in, submitted questionnaires out, entirely online.

why_ai: Factor models are entrenched industry language but small quant teams whose output scales with compute.
why_clarity: Covariance forecasts are backtested objectively against realised returns.
why_digital: Return histories in, models and optimisers out, licensed globally.

why_ai: Statutory supervisory authority and enforcement cannot be delegated to AI; demand grows with complexity.
why_clarity: Filing reviews recur, but examination and rulemaking outcomes are contested and slow.
why_digital: Filings are digital, but exams happen onsite and regulated firms cannot choose their regulator.

why_ai: Routine votes automate; company engagement and politically scrutinised contested votes keep human judgment.
why_clarity: Each vote must evidence the stated policy, but engagement outcomes resolve slowly.
why_digital: Votes cast on platforms; engagement includes meetings with company boards.

why_ai: Grounded commentary drafting automates; client meetings representing the team keep some relationship value.
why_clarity: Quarterly commentary must be number-accurate and PM-approved on a fixed cycle.
why_digital: Attribution data drafted on screens; client meetings and finals often in person.
